description: Shared enrichment wire vectors. Clone the named base, apply set paths, then remove paths. Shape vectors run identically in Node/static-browser/Python. invalidSemantic vectors remain shape-valid; only TypeScript enrichmentIssues and the browser/owning consumers enforce these cross-field rules. Hashes are lexical fixtures, not cryptographic attestations.

valid.name: completed parallel job matches explicit request
queued job has no published result
preparing job has no published result
generating job has no published result
cancelled job has no published result
selected subtree can omit base ancestor
paginated generated parent need not be present
overlapping page ranges fit six physical pages

invalidShape.name: null recipe is not a v1 default
provider cannot be selected by request
browser paths are not document IDs
model-enhanced tree is not a base mode
geometry cannot be added to navigation nodes
result requires at least one node
job must use a real timestamp
tree preview must be a page
list descriptor has bounded node count
list descriptor cannot expose request or owner
read page has at most 50 complete nodes
read page result hash has canonical form

invalidSemantic.name: old absent-recipe job cannot be silently upgraded
parallel request cannot return serial result
completed job must publish a result
cancelled job cannot claim failure reason
completed job cannot contain failure reason
aggregate node count respects job budget
overlapping page ranges count once but exceed five
null summary cannot declare model origin
decision must name an included node
tree page cannot repeat final offset
list empty nonfinal page cannot loop
page empty nonfinal page cannot loop
page node summary kind is checked
